decisions.reason: The net price display plugin serves the firm's B2B shop clients with little upkeep, but its absence from the website since 2020 suggests it may not have been ported to newer shop platform versions.
The ERP interface remains central to the multichannel strategy and to client lock-in, which justifies the cost of maintaining it despite its lower visibility online.
Two sibling price comparison plugins were already withdrawn and this one has not been visible since 2020, so its resources are better spent on core shop optimization and new development.
Net price reporting still complements the B2B display plugin at minimal cost, though its fading web presence raises the risk of withdrawal.
